title: Under a federal integrity agreement, or in a category the 2026 moratoria name
question: Which San Francisco provider numbers carry the name of a company under a federal integrity agreement, and how much Medicaid money goes to the kinds of provider that the 2026 federal enrollment freezes single out?
finding: The federal list of 334 integrity agreements names 2 companies whose exact name is on San Francisco provider numbers with a second link through the registry's mailing address (1 in the same city as the agreement, 1 in the same State only): Medi-Lynx Cardiac Monitoring (1 San Francisco number; 1 agreement, the latest listed as Closed Oct 05, 2022); Walgreen Co (65 San Francisco numbers; 2 agreements, the latest listed as Effective Apr 18, 2025). 2 more names match with no second link and are not shown. The 2026 federal freezes on new Medicare enrollment name hospices and home health agencies. The national registry has 33 hospice provider numbers in San Francisco (3 paid by Medicaid as billers, $3.8 million from 2018 to 2024) and 82 in its home-health group (8 paid, $10.6 million); 6 and 33 of those numbers were issued in 2022 or later.
how: Agreements: each company named in an entry of the federal list of corporate integrity agreements was compared with the registered names of organizations in the project's provider universe. A row needs the same name after removing punctuation and legal endings, at least one number registered in San Francisco, and a second link: the national registry's mailing address for that name in the same city as the agreement's listed home, or (marked weaker) in the same State when that State is not California. Moratoria: provider numbers registered in San Francisco whose provider type in the national registry is hospice, home health agency or medical equipment supplier, with what the Medicaid payment file shows under them as billers.
limits: An integrity agreement is a settlement term, not a finding of wrongdoing by any one pharmacy or clinic: it binds the company that signed it, usually nationwide, and the list shows closed agreements as well as live ones. The match is by name, and the second link is a mailing address, so a different company with the same name in the same city would be caught and a subsidiary under another name is missed. The moratoria stop new Medicare enrollments only; the notices leave each State to decide about Medicaid, they do not touch providers already enrolled, and they say nothing about any San Francisco provider. Being a hospice, a home health agency or an equipment supplier is not a warning sign. Provider type comes from the registry, which providers fill in themselves; this project’s home-health group is built from four registry type codes and is wider than the agencies Medicare certifies, and a new provider number is not a new Medicare enrollment. Medicaid amounts are lower bounds (small cells are withheld) and cover outpatient and professional services only.

rows.name: Walgreen Co
rows.detail: Corporate Integrity Agreement, Effective Apr 18, 2025, listed at Deerfield, IL; also Corporate Integrity Agreement, Closed Jul 16, 2024
rows.secondLink: Weaker link: the national registry gives its mailing address in the same State as the agreement (IL), not the same city
